transcript: A tight deadline... okay, so one time a customer needed a report of all their users' activity by the end of the day for their audit. I got the request in the afternoon, around three. I didn't really know how to pull that report, so I asked around the team, but everyone was busy. So I just started doing it by hand, going into each user's page and copying things into Excel. There were a lot of users, maybe a hundred and fifty. It took me until almost eleven at night. I was very tired but I sent it to them before the morning, so technically it was late but they didn't complain. I was proud that I didn't give up. My manager said thank you the next day. Later someone told me there was an export button that could have done it in two minutes, haha, so that was a bit frustrating to hear. But it shows I'm committed and I'll do whatever it takes for the customer. Next time I would probably ask my manager earlier, I guess, instead of trying to figure it out alone.
